name: Levioth
source:
The charismatic leader of all the Knight Troupes.
A top class swordsman and sorcerer.
He often acts alone, a mysterious man who doesn't have close connections with people.
He has a bigger objective besides leading the knights, but only [url=/c43956]Kain[/url] and [url=/c43957]Kiefer[/url] know that.
